master.prompt:
Edit this headless cyan sweatshirt / cream cargo trousers / orange shoes sprite sheet. Keep its 6 columns x 2 rows, same outfit, transparent background, short neck anchors, chibi proportions. Correct BOTH ARMS AND LEGS to a natural contralateral walk. Current arms are WRONG because they stay in the same phase. NO head, NO labels.
Definition: angles measured from vertical downward; positive = forward in direction of travel. Anatomical left/right are permanent limb identities, not screen sides.
Six columns MUST depict:
1 left thigh +30°, right thigh -30°, LEFT ARM -25° behind torso, RIGHT ARM +25° ahead. Left foot heel-strikes, right heel lifts.
2 left thigh +10° supporting, right thigh -15° with knee bent 55°, left arm -10°, right arm +10°.
3 left thigh -10° supporting, right thigh +10° knee bent 60° swinging past planted ankle, LEFT ARM +10° ahead, RIGHT ARM -10° behind.
4 left thigh -30° BACKWARD, right thigh +30° FORWARD, LEFT ARM +25° FORWARD, RIGHT ARM -25° BACKWARD. Right heel strikes. THIS MUST EXCHANGE BOTH ARM AND LEG POSITIONS FROM FRAME 1.
5 left thigh -15° knee bent 55° swinging, right thigh +10° supporting, LEFT ARM +10° ahead, RIGHT ARM -10° behind.
6 left thigh +10° knee bent 60° passing in front of planted right leg, right thigh -10° supporting, LEFT ARM -10° behind, RIGHT ARM +10° ahead.
Upper row faces SCREEN LEFT: anatomical LEFT arm and leg are camera-near, visibly occluding far limbs. Specifically col1 near HAND is on SCREEN RIGHT of chest while near FOOT is SCREEN LEFT of hip. Col4 near HAND is SCREEN LEFT of chest, clearly visible over orange bag/lower chest, while near FOOT is SCREEN RIGHT of hip. In col4 the far hand is behind the torso on screen right, partly occluded. Col3 and col5 near hand is slightly left of shoulder. Col2 and col6 near hand slightly right of shoulder.
Lower row faces SCREEN RIGHT: anatomical RIGHT arm and leg are camera-near. Col1 near RIGHT hand is SCREEN RIGHT of chest while near RIGHT foot is SCREEN LEFT of hip. Col4 near RIGHT hand is SCREEN LEFT of chest while near RIGHT foot is SCREEN RIGHT of hip.
Draw the near sleeve as LIGHT cyan and far sleeve as darker teal; near trouser leg light cream and far leg tan. Keep same shade identity as limbs swing. Near elbow and forearm must OVERLAP IN FRONT OF THE TORSO when swung forward; never simply keep both hands beside the body. Avoid rigid arms, marching same-side arm and leg together, duplicate half-cycles. Columns3/6 feet narrow and crossing, cols1/4 wide contact with opposite bright leg. Correct visible foot/hand oppositions are more important than preserving mistaken poses.
